title: Independent pair expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $h:\Omega\times\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The independent pair expectation of $h$ is the iterated expectation $\mathbb{E}_{\omega\sim\pi}\mathbb{E}_{\omega'\sim\pi}[h(\omega,\omega')]$, with the two samples drawn independently from $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
